title: Landmine Romanian Deadlift
summary: A hip hinge holding the end of a landmine bar, which loads the hamstrings and glutes on a forgiving arc.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: landmine attachment; barbell (Olympic bar); weight plates.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.9 for hamstrings (main mover): each working set adds 0.9 of a set to the weekly hamstrings total.
Library rating 0.8 for glutes (main mover): each working set adds 0.8 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.4 for lower back (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly lower back total.
Library rating 0.3 for adductors (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly adductors total.
Library rating 0.2 for traps: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly traps total.
Library rating 0.2 for forearms: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly forearms total.

setup.text: Stand facing the bar end, hold it with both hands at arm's length, with soft knees.
Push your hips back and let the bar slide down your thighs until your hamstrings are stretched.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

form_cues.cue: Reach your hips back, not your hands down.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
